correctness.rationale: With d01=p,d12=r,d02=q the proof computes 2C_000(A/B/C) exactly as 2p+q+r, p+q+2r and p+r+2q, and the three individual switching coefficients for each pair. The two exact affine cost differences over t∈{0,1}³ attain maxima p-r+max(0,2p-q) and p-q+max(0,2p-r). Triangle inequality q≤p+r≤2r makes both nonpositive iff 3p≤q+r. In the complementary region all-average forces a shortest edge, but t=(1,0,0) strictly favors a different edge by (3p-q-r)/2, hence no universal solution. Ties and boundaries included. The extracted standard-library script directly recomputes eight type profiles, affine identities, and witnesses for 8327 integer plus 3339 rational triangles; finite computations do not substitute for analytic proof.

The surprising obstruction (3,4,4) defeats each homogeneous-optimal pair only for a mixed profile; the line-three-sites positive result versus line-four-sites negative example identifies a sharp natural geometry/market-size boundary. This is substantive exact structural information for heterogeneous committee/facility choices beyond published approximation factors, not arbitrary parameter enumeration.
